name: Couch lineage
summary: A listing's history inside the friend group as a price curve with each owner's story, and a way to keep it in the family.
useWhen: a friend lists something that has passed between friends before
'this couch has been in the group since freshman year', 'who wants it next'
dontUseWhen: a new listing with no history in the group (use price-check)
selling many things before moving (use move-out-sale)

params.title: card title
params.item: what it is, e.g. 'green velvet couch'
params.eras: 2-8 x {who, year, paidCents, place, lore}, oldest first; the last is the current seller
params.next: year the next owner would take it
